basis: The mapped station and photographs resolve the north-facing gate, the two clock towers and south rail platforms. The shared datum uses a standard terrain sample in the north forecourt. A bounded plaza surface exposes the gate and courtyard grade. Platform roofs preserve the mapped rail paths and seat their supports at sampled grade.
limits: Forecourt and platform elevations are visual estimates from the mapped plan and standard terrain. The platform roofs use locally fitted support heights and retain the eight modeled rows and existing rail gaps.
The model depicts the permanent passenger exterior. Fine thresholds, hidden rooms and temporary works are approximate or outside the model scope.
